security: Class A ordinary shares, par value $0.001 per share
footnote_text: Amber Global Limited ("AGL") effected a pro-rata in-kind distribution to its shareholders of all 309,834,748 Class A Ordinary Shares of the Issuer previously held by AGL (the "Share Distribution"). In the Share Distribution, Amber Fort Limited ("AFL"), Amber Primary Unit Holding Limited ("APUH"), Digital Future Alliance Limited ("DFAL") and Amber Alliance Limited ("AAL") received 69,552,266, 19,458,931, 6,698,479 and 4,620,646 Class A ordinary shares, respectively. The remaining Class A ordinary shares were distributed to other shareholders of AGL and are no longer reported as beneficially owned by the Reporting Person. The Reporting Person is the sole shareholder of APUH, the sole voting shareholder of DFAL and AAL, and the sole director of each of APUH, DFAL and AAL, and may be deemed to beneficially own the shares held by each such entity.
